names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου», with the rank word and the see left off.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1385, «Лукиан Печерский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; the day line gives «Лукиана Печерского».

death.note: The Russian day line, and the only year any of the four calendars gives him: «Сщмч. Лукиана Печерского (1243)». The Greek page that first brought him into the corpus says outright that it has no details of his life, and gives no year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Лукиана Печерского (1243).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day's three icons all stand in the paragraph above it, each immediately before its own entry.

attestations.note: The same menologion day the folder already keeps for the Greek, and the same man — the hieromartyr presbyter of the Caves. **This calendar adds exactly one fact and withholds everything else.** The fact is the year, 1243, which the Greek page could not give; and the withholding is that the line carries no life link at all, where almost every other entry on the day does, so the Russian has no account of him either. The name index page 1385 prints his name, his rank and the one day, and nothing more. So the folder still stands on its line, now with a year on it.

Not on doxologia.ro's calendar for 15 octombrie, the same menologion day the Greek and the Russian keep him on — its entries for the day are Magdalena of Mălainița, Euthymius the New, Lucian the priest of Antioch, Vars bishop of Edessa and Savin bishop of Cyprus (read 28 October 2026). No other day checked.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος των Σπηλαίων του Κιέβου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Αγιος Λουκιανος ο Ιερομαρτυρας Πρεσβυτερος Των Σπηλαιων Του Κιεβου». **Its whole notice is one sentence and it is a refusal**: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου» — we have no details of the saint's life. So everything here comes out of the line: the ranks ιερομάρτυς and πρεσβύτερος, which are the two `types`, and the Caves of Kyiv, which the line names outright and which is therefore in the display name. No year, so no `dates`; no place recorded beyond that name, so no `locations`; no hymn and no verse. **The same day's other Lucian is a different man and is an upgrade, not this folder**: «Άγιος Λουκιανός ο ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος της Εκκλησίας της Αντιοχείας», `/2595/`, is the corpus's `lucian-of-antioch`, of Samosata, who died of hunger at Nicomedia under Diocletian, and saint.gr prints the two as two entries with two pages on one day. The corpus's other men of the name — `lucian-of-tomis`, `lucian-fedotov`, `lucianus-companion-of-peregrinus` — stand on other days. The «Σοφιστής και συγγραφέας της αρχαιότητας (120 - 200 μ.Χ.)» line is saint.gr's note on the name Lucian and not a statement about this saint. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

Not in the Ohrid Prologue for 15 October old style as the Православни подсетник prints it (pravoslavno.rs for 28.10.2026, read 28 October 2026). Its two entries that day are the other Lucian — «Преп. муч. Лукијан презв. Антиохијски», the presbyter of Antioch, with a full paragraph — and Euthymius the New; neither is this man. No other day checked.
